{"metadata":{"description":"Mimir — 一站式科研工作台插件：LaTeX 论文边写边编译、arXiv 文献管理、实验追踪、指标图表、GPU 服务器 SSH 任务编排，管理科研全周期。An open-source research workbench plugin for the whole research cycle.","id":"gh:1340749561","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-Mimir-Academic-research","slug":"1692775560/dsh-Mimir-Academic-research","topics":["arxiv","bibtex","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","experiment-tracking","gpu-cluster","latex","paper-writing","research","research-tools","ssh"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Mimir — 一站式科研工作台插件：LaTeX 论文边写边编译、arXiv 文献管理、实验追踪、指标图表、GPU 服务器 SSH 任务编排，管理科研全周期。An open-source resear"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ch workbench plugin for the whole research cycle."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Mimir"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"The research-lifecycle copilot inside DeepSeek Harness:"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"literature · experiments & remote GPUs · figures · LaTeX writing → compile → preview · group-meeting"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" decks — one workbench, driven by your agent."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English · 中文 · Website"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Mimir is a single npm package (`dsh-mimir`) that plugs into dsh and gives you:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Nine-view web workbench** (sidebar toggle → overlay, dark/light, 中/EN):
**Overview** pipeline & "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"stats · **Paper** Overleaf-style LaTeX studio (edit → compile → PDF preview, one-click AI fix) · **L"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ibrary** arXiv + web search, AI relevance scoring, fullscreen PDF reader · **Experiments** metric ch"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"arts, one-click paper figures · **Figures** upload/organize/insert into the paper · **Meetings** one"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"-click group-meeting PPT (real paper figures + optional AI illustrations) · **Servers** GPU fleet pr"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"obes + remote jobs · **Ledger** humanized research journal — idea evolution auto-captured into a wor"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ktree, six-perspective digest capsules, one-click progress report · **Venues** CCF conference-deadli"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ne countdown (ccfddl catalog, per-project watchlist) + CCF-A journal directory — every view live-ref"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"reshes over SSE as the agent writes, no manual reload
- **Agent tools & slash commands**: `/research"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"-idea` `/research-plan` `/research-review` `/paper-write` `/paper-compile`, plus `arxiv_search`, `we"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"b_search`, `wiki_note`, `figure_save`, `latex_compile`, `meeting_deck`, `venue_search`, and the remo"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"te-compute quartet `server_list` / `server_check` / `server_submit_job` / `server_list_jobs` (same r"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"emembered servers and jobs as the Servers tab)
- **Eleven bundled research skills** (literature revi"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ew, novelty check, experiment planning, citation audit, bilingual de-AI polish, rebuttal…) that teac"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"h the agent the workflow — no setup needed"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Overview | Paper | Library | Experiments |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Figures | Meetings | Servers | Ledger |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"▶ Full MP4 demo (22 MB)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 22, the dsh CLI (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`), and a `DEEPSEEK_API_KE"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"Y` for agent sessions."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Got an old version (e.g. 0.11.x/0.12.x)? dsh's plugin store uses pnpm, which holds back freshly publ"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ished releases by default. Pin the exact version instead: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mimir"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" && dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mimir@0.23.0`"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Version compatibility: **0.23.0 requires dsh ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1** (upstream removed the runtime-invariants"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" package and replaced the global current-session API with mainView retention + `uiWorkspace.openSess"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ion`; verified against 0.2.1-alpha.2). 0.21.0 and 0.21.1 are broken on dsh 0.2.x — their Typert mani"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"fest still emitted the retired `schema:` codec, so the whole `research` Remote failed to compose and"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" every workspace read as empty; upgrade to 0.23.0. On dsh 0.1.x, pin the previous release: `dsh plug"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"in --profile web add dsh-mimir@0.21.0`. **0.18.x–0.21.1 require dsh ≥ 0.1.2-alpha.4**; on an older d"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"b add dsh-mimir@0.21.0`. **0.18.x–0.21.1 require dsh ≥ 0.1.2-alpha.4**; on an older dsh, pin 0.16.0."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Click **Mimir** in the sidebar footer. The wiki persists at `~/.dsh/storages/research_wiki.json`; ar"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"tifacts land under `./.research`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Optional capabilities:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Paper compilation** — install a LaTeX engine (`brew install tectonic` is easiest), or set `latex"},{"id":"p19s2","text":".engine` to a binary path
- **Web search** — the digdig CLI (`dg`) ships with the package; give it a"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" SearXNG server with one command (Docker-free, local venv):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Zotero** — set `zotero.apiKey` / `zotero.userId` in the plugin config (keys at zotero.org/settin"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ro** — set `zotero.apiKey` / `zotero.userId` in the plugin config (keys at zotero.org/settings/keys)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Related projects"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Mimir-Desktop** — a standalone Electron desktop edition of the workbench: no dsh install, no bac"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"kend to run, same feature set. Community-maintained by @hxhy00, MIT."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"All keys are optional; set them in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (full commented example: example"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"s/mimir-agent/cordis.yml)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `workspaceDir` | `.research` | Research workspace root (artifacts, backups) |
| `latex.engine` | `"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"auto` | `latexmk` / `tectonic` probe, or absolute binary path |
| `search.command` | `auto` | Web se"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"arch: `auto` uses `dg` from PATH or the bundled copy |
| `reviewer.maxRounds` | `3` | Per-project re"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"view-round budget |
| `backup.enabled` / `intervalMinutes` / `keep` | `true` / `60` / `24` | Schedul"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ed wiki snapshots |
| `skills.enabled` | `true` | Register the eleven bundled research skills |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Plugin not found** — dsh resolves plugin names from the profile directory; install with `dsh plu"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"gin --profile web add dsh-mimir@latest`, not from your cwd.
- **`Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/d"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"sh-…'` at startup** — the profile has the plugin but none of the dsh packages the host is supposed t"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"o provide. Mimir imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`, `dsh-tools`, `dsh-atomic-write`, `dsh-ll"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"m` and `dsh-typert-protocol` at module scope, because `@Remote` decorators and the wiki domain spec "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"are evaluated when the module loads; they cannot be loaded lazily or bundled (they hand the plugin t"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"he host's own `Service` and tool-registry instances). An installer that provisions a package's peers"},{"id":"p29s8","text":" — `dsh plugin … add`, or `npm`/`pnpm` with peer installation left on — makes them resolvable; one t"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"hat does not leaves the plugin unable to import. If you hit this, reinstall through `dsh plugin --pr"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"ofile <profile> add dsh-mimir@latest` rather than copying the package into the profile by hand.
- **"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"LaTeX engine not found** — `brew install tectonic`, or point `latex.engine` at an absolute path. Fir"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"st tectonic compile downloads packages; raise `latex.timeoutMs` if it times out.
- **arXiv fails** —"},{"id":"p29s13","text":" export `HTTPS_PROXY` before starting dsh when behind a proxy.
- **Web search unavailable** — run `b"},{"id":"p29s14","text":"ash scripts/setup-web-search.sh` (local SearXNG), or `dg init` against your own instance, then resta"},{"id":"p29s15","text":"ipts/setup-web-search.sh` (local SearXNG), or `dg init` against your own instance, then restart dsh."}],"truncated":true}
